subject: how to get longer tickmarks for some ticks?

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: how to get longer tickmarks for some ticks?
parts:
Dear expeRts,

I managed to get ticks for every bin in a barplot (see minimal example
below).
If you have many tickmarks and large numbers at the tickmarks, it is
sometimes
difficult for the eye to tell which of the tickmarks the label belongs
to. It
would thus be nice to have longer tickmarks for those ticks that have
a label.
How can I achieve that?

Cheers,

Marius


library(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(Time=1:20, Number=round(20*runif(20)))

qplot(Number, weight=Time, data=df, geom="bar", binwidth=1) +
scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:20,
labels=c("","","","",5,"","","","",
10,"","","","",15,"","","","",20))

It's not currently possible. It could one day be possible with the
work that Kohske's is doing to make the guides more generalisable.

Hadley
